_comment: Regex deny-list for scripts/check-public-safety.js. Case-insensitive. Owner-specific identifiers go in ~/.config/aigora/public-denylist.json (or $AIGORA_PUBLIC_DENYLIST), never here. allowFileLines exempts matching lines of one named file from the deny patterns (the intended identity/attribution lines); it never exempts secrets. The files listed in allowFiles are excluded from the scan. The /home pattern deliberately skips obvious placeholder users (user, you, me, x, alice, ...).
